div.p: I, ______________________ s/o/d/o _____________________ residing at _________________________________________________________________________________ hereby declare that I understand the External media communication policy of the company. All inquiries seeking an official response or statement specific to Ekara Partnership should be directed to the Director or any other person authorized by the Director for communications.

Authorization to speak on behalf of the Ekara Partnership may only be given by the Director for Communications. No staff member may make official statements on behalf of the organization without consultation with, and express authorization from, the Director.

I understand the Company maintains the right to monitor company-related employee activity in social networks. Employees are prohibited from disclosing or discussing any of the company’s confidential or proprietary information, or any information regarding the company’s clients or business partners, or details of a particular client engagement, in any online social networking and blogging activities. The fact that a particular entity or person is a client or business partner of the company must be treated as confidential and should not be mentioned in any online social networking and blogging activities.

Employees are prohibited from using the trademarks, logos, other identifying marks or copyright-protected material of the company or its clients in any online social networking and blogging activities.
Employees also are prohibited from including their company email address in their personal profiles on social networking sites.
I understand that violation of these guidelines is grounds for disciplinary action up to and including dismissal from employment.
